exclusion_reason: The schema-2 lane bundle envelope is implemented in the run surface: a schema-pinned envelope carries the lane, the executable, the capability manifest, and provenance, and a lane that mismatches its payload is refused. The benchmark remains red because the one-host-loads-every-lane proof needs the web-native and emulator runtime that are still absent.
promotion_trigger: Promote when every lane round-trips through the envelope and the mismatch case is refused.
active_gate_evidence: The security test runs a schema-2 lane bundle through the real run surface and refuses both a payload mismatch (lane_payload_mismatch) and an absent lane runtime (lane_not_available).
procedure: Round-trip each lane through the envelope.
Validate the schema pin and the capability manifest per lane.
Mismatch a lane against its payload and assert refusal.
